hazards.reason: Copying account holds the database's write lock for time that grows with the table.
hazards.subject: table/account

hazards.reason: Account.name becomes unique: servers built from the previous version may write duplicates.
hazards.subject: table/account/constraint/account_name_key

hazards.reason: Building the unique index fails when account holds duplicate values of Account.name.
hazards.subject: table/account/constraint/account_name_key

hazards.reason: SQLite's ALTER TABLE cannot drop NOT NULL from name, so the step rebuilds account: it copies the rows into a new table, drops the old one and renames the new one, with foreign keys off.
hazards.subject: table/account

statements:
CREATE TABLE "_new_account" (
  "id" TEXT DEFAULT (lower(hex(randomblob(4)) || '-' || hex(randomblob(2)) || '-4' || substr(hex(randomblob(2)), 2) || '-' || substr('89ab', 1 + (random() & 3), 1) || substr(hex(randomblob(2)), 2) || '-' || hex(randomblob(6)))) NOT NULL,
  "name" TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
steps.subject: table/account

hazards.reason: Copying entry holds the database's write lock for time that grows with the table.
hazards.subject: table/entry

hazards.reason: Entry.memo becomes required: the step fails when entry has a row where memo is null.
hazards.subject: table/entry/column/memo

hazards.reason: SQLite's ALTER TABLE cannot make memo NOT NULL, so the step rebuilds entry: it copies the rows into a new table, drops the old one and renames the new one, with foreign keys off.
hazards.subject: table/entry

statements:
CREATE TABLE "_new_entry" (
  "id" TEXT DEFAULT (lower(hex(randomblob(4)) || '-' || hex(randomblob(2)) || '-4' || substr(hex(randomblob(2)), 2) || '-' || substr('89ab', 1 + (random() & 3), 1) || substr(hex(randomblob(2)), 2) || '-' || hex(randomblob(6)))) NOT NULL,
  "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "memo" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("account_id") REFERENCES "account" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE
)
steps.subject: table/entry
